add_monitor_task: Add one published video URL to an authorized monitoring project.
add_monitor_task_labels: Add up to 100 labels to up to 100 tasks in one authorized monitoring project.
add_not_interested_creators: Mark up to 100 same-platform creator IDs as Not interested.
apply_collection_add_to_crm: Apply add one whole collection + platform slice to CRM.
apply_collection_batch_copy: Apply batch copy from one source collection.
apply_collection_batch_delete: Apply batch delete within one source collection.
apply_collection_batch_label: Apply batch label within one source collection.
apply_collection_batch_move: Apply batch move within one source collection.
apply_collection_unlock_audience: Apply unlock audience analysis for one source collection.
campaign2_auto_advance_settings_apply: Apply only submitted automatic advancement fields; does not apply unrelated plan drafts or change any switch.
campaign2_auto_advance_settings_get: Read the auto-advance settings for the selected intelligent marketing plan.
campaign2_auto_discovery_settings_delete: Delete automatic discovery settings. Uses current Campaign context and server permissions.
campaign2_auto_discovery_settings_get: Read automatic discovery settings. Uses current Campaign context and server permissions.
campaign2_auto_discovery_settings_save: Save automatic-discovery settings as {enabled,config}; the selected campaign_id determines scope. Saving does not start discovery.
campaign2_auto_discovery_switch: Enable or disable automatic discovery. Uses current Campaign context and server permissions.
campaign2_automations_get: Read which automation settings are active for the selected intelligent marketing plan.
campaign2_automations_switch: Set one existing module switch. The campaign master switch still gates automatic work; this does not immediately send mail.
campaign2_candidates_add: Add creators returned by creator_search to a Campaign candidate list. Pass the encrypted search/profile creator_id in each target; the server converts it to the raw platform channel ID before calling Campaign2. Do not pass creator_id as channel_id.
campaign2_candidates_list: Read the current Campaign candidates list with pagination, platform counts, profile status and plan notes. For YouTube, Instagram and TikTok pass returned creator_id directly to Campaign write targets. X (platform 3) has creator_id=null and raw channel_id; creator-token tools do not support X.
campaign2_candidates_remove: Remove creators from Campaign candidates. Uses current Campaign context and server permissions.
campaign2_context: Read the authorized Campaign detail and discovery settings. data.campaign.inputOptions.targetMarkets contains current country wire values and status; copy items[].value when status=ok. Unavailable options are not an empty allowed set. inputOptions is read-only and must not be submitted as settings.
campaign2_cooperations_add: Add one creator by verified public profile URL to the Campaign negotiation list using the page's manual-add workflow. Does not create a formal CRM cooperation record or send outreach. Read back the cooperation list; do not overwrite existing cooperation states.
campaign2_cooperations_label_assign: Assign cooperation labels to the selected Campaign cooperation records.
campaign2_cooperations_label_create: Create a cooperation label for a Campaign.
campaign2_cooperations_label_delete: Delete the selected Campaign cooperation label.
campaign2_cooperations_label_update: Update the selected Campaign cooperation label.
campaign2_cooperations_labels_list: List cooperation labels for the selected Campaign.
campaign2_cooperations_list: Read the cooperation workspace with its actual status and counts. Platform filtering is not supported by this server endpoint.
campaign2_cooperations_record_save: Save shared CRM cooperation details: mode full requires complete commercial fields; mode inline uses the Campaign partial-entry endpoint. New records use version 0, edits use the returned id/version. The adapter converts platform identity and derives a stable UUIDv4 requestId.
campaign2_cooperations_status_update: Update one Campaign creator cooperation status. Use the current cooperation record and version when available.
campaign2_discovery_search: Search creators for Campaign discovery. Uses current Campaign context and server permissions.
campaign2_discovery_snapshot_get: Read one historical Campaign discovery search condition and bounded creator result page.
campaign2_discovery_snapshot_save: Save an immutable completed discovery page with resolved creator identities. Does not run a search or add candidates. Reuse request_id only for the same page payload; normal Campaign discovery uses conversation/list history instead of extra snapshots.
campaign2_discovery_snapshots_list: List bounded historical Campaign discovery search summaries by cursor.
campaign2_invitation_pending_add: Move creators returned by creator_search directly to invitation pending. Pass encrypted creator_id values; the server converts them to raw platform channel IDs.
campaign2_invitations_automation_get: Read invitation automation settings for the selected Campaign.
campaign2_invitations_automation_switch: Change the invitation automation switch for the selected Campaign.
campaign2_invitations_detail: Read actual invitation history and frozen plaintext for one creator. Use optional dispatch_task_id from a previous detail response to pin the same task or legacy message bounds; omit for latest history. Does not prepare, apply, send or unlock contacts.
campaign2_invitations_import_collection: Import creators from a collection into the selected Campaign's invitation workflow.
campaign2_invitations_list: Read the current invitation list. pending allows waiting or queued; sent allows unreplied, readUnreply, replied or bounce. Failures, bounces and uncertain delivery results are in sent/bounce. Do not use pending/failed. Uses scoped Campaign permissions and preserves actual unknown, empty and zero values.
campaign2_invitations_metrics: Read invitation metrics for the selected Campaign.
campaign2_invitations_preflight: Check the exact 1–100 selected pending creators without creating a task, unlocking email or charging sending quota. This is the authoritative contact and configuration diagnosis.
campaign2_invitations_readiness: Check invitation readiness for the selected Campaign.
campaign2_invitations_regions: Read the current invitation region options. pending allows waiting or queued; sent allows unreplied, readUnreply, replied or bounce. Failures, bounces and uncertain delivery results are in sent/bounce. Do not use pending/failed. Uses scoped Campaign permissions and preserves actual unknown, empty and zero values.
campaign2_invitations_send: Preview actual recipients, sender, effective content and schedule, then wait for explicit second user confirmation before execute. Start: 1–100 creators; resend/retry: one. Unknown results must be queried, never automatically resent.
campaign2_invitations_send_result: Read the original sending attempt by its idempotency key. Accepted does not mean sent or delivered.
campaign2_invitations_sender_options: Read sender accounts for this Campaign through its unique invitation project and creator-owned account directory. Returns all available Gmail, enterprise, Outlook and Nox business identities. auth_info_id and primary_project_id are exact decimal strings. Copy invitation_sender for available accounts into settings.sender; account_settings_read_only describes account management, not Campaign send permission. This is read-only and does not confirm sender selection, quota or sending.
campaign2_invitations_sequence: Read the invitation sequence for the selected Campaign.
campaign2_invitations_settings_apply: Apply invitation settings to the selected Campaign.
campaign2_invitations_settings_get: Read invitation settings for the selected Campaign.
campaign2_invitations_settings_reset: Discard unapplied invitation edits in the plan or one creator scope. Preserves applied settings and sent history.
campaign2_invitations_settings_save: Save an invitation draft with readable content. Sender uses type (1 Gmail, 2 enterprise, 3 Nox, 4 Outlook) and authInfoIds from sender-options; aliases are normalized. Does not apply settings or send email. In target scope, provide a non-empty rounds array from settings-get and preserve its structure. Legacy contents-only settings are for global scope. For a frozen legacyContents journey, preserve all round timing fields and edit copy only.
campaign2_invitations_state: Change invitation state. Bulk cancel waiting or queued invitations in ONE request with targets (1-1000 creators), or all_matching plus expected_count and optional min_sub/max_sub/regions filters. For queued cancellation set status_group=queued: creators already sent, sending, uncertain, replied or otherwise changed are skipped; other cancellable creators continue. Report data.cancelledCount and data.skippedCount, including zero cancellations. Waiting is the default strict scope. Never loop single-creator cancellation for a batch. Choose exactly one scope: target, task_id, targets, all_matching. Batch scopes only support action=cancel; status_group is only valid with targets or all_matching. All-matching queued counts may shrink but must not grow beyond expected_count.
campaign2_invitations_task: Read the selected Campaign invitation task.
campaign2_not_interested_list: Read the current Campaign not-interested list with pagination, platform counts, profile status and plan notes. For YouTube, Instagram and TikTok pass returned creator_id directly to Campaign write targets. X (platform 3) has creator_id=null and raw channel_id; creator-token tools do not support X.
campaign2_not_interested_mark: Mark creators returned by creator_search as not interested. Pass encrypted creator_id values; the server converts them to raw platform channel IDs.
campaign2_not_interested_restore: Restore creators from not-interested. Uses current Campaign context and server permissions.
campaign2_notes_save: Edit a plan note only when the user requests it; preserves concurrent-edit protection. AI selection reasons belong in candidate/invitation/cooperation actions, not this USER-note endpoint.
campaign2_plan_create: Create a Campaign2 draft using an allocated ID. Does not apply settings or send invitations. Uses the existing Campaign create/update Skill Credit price (default 1); quota is checked before mutation.
campaign2_plan_delete: Preview then confirm soft deletion of a Campaign. Obtain explicit user confirmation before execute.
campaign2_plan_get: Read details for the selected intelligent marketing plan.
campaign2_plan_init: Allocate a new Campaign ID; does not create or apply a plan.
campaign2_plan_list: List and filter intelligent marketing plans for the authorized account.
campaign2_plan_members: List members of the selected intelligent marketing plan.
campaign2_plan_metrics: Read metrics for the selected intelligent marketing plan.
campaign2_plan_overview: Read the overview of the selected intelligent marketing plan.
campaign2_plan_settings_apply: Apply the saved plan draft. Does not apply invitation settings or send email. Uses the existing Campaign create/update Skill Credit price (default 1); quota is checked before mutation.
campaign2_plan_settings_save: Save a plan draft patch. Omitted fields are preserved; explicit null clears. Applied settings remain unchanged.
campaign2_plan_status: Set the existing Campaign master automation status; manual operations and history remain available.
campaign2_products_add: Add one existing product-center record or inline product to a Campaign. mode=draft saves only; mode=apply applies only this product and preserves unrelated draft edits. Existing matching products are preserved. No fixed search/create sequence is required.
campaign2_search_condition_get: Read saved Campaign search condition. Uses current Campaign context and server permissions.
campaign2_search_condition_save: Save a JSON-object search condition snapshot. search_type is required: 1 ordinary search for manual paging, 2 AI matching, 3 AI expansion. This saves filters only; it does not start search or invitation sending.
create_collection_export: Create an async collection export task.
create_creator_export: Create a base or deep asynchronous export for 1-100 selected creator search results after user approval; deep contact fields can consume business quota.
create_creator_lookalikes_export: Create a base or deep asynchronous export for 1-100 selected similar-creator results after user approval; deep contact fields can consume business quota.
create_monitor_label: Create or reuse one video monitor label in a selected label group.
create_monitor_project: Create one video monitoring project for the authorized account.
creator_audience: Read audience demographics and authenticity metrics for a creator.
creator_content: Read recent content and topic signals for a creator.
creator_cooperation: Read brand cooperation and sponsorship performance metrics for a creator.
creator_profile: Read profile metrics for a creator returned by search, or by direct platform selector. creator_id is an opaque creator ID returned by creator_search; channel_id is the raw platform ID used by Campaign2 and other legacy business APIs. Never substitute creator_id for channel_id.
creator_search: Search YouTube, TikTok, or Instagram creators by topic keywords or one creator name/handle, with optional exclusions and SaaS hide filters. Results contain entitled filter values and SaaS list fields; TikTok live overviews require explicit creator_profile detail=true, include_shop=true. Search never fetches details or returns cumulative/product GMV snapshots or contact addresses. The returned item.id is an opaque creator ID for creator_profile and must never be copied into Campaign2 targets[].channelId; Campaign2 requires the raw platform channel_id. YouTube avg_views stays overall; average-view bounds use avg_views_shorts for video_type=1, avg_views_normal for video_type=2, and avg_views otherwise. These are search-index snapshots, not profile-detail samples; missing classified values stay null.
delete_monitor_label: Delete one authorized video monitor label after explicit user approval.
filter_creator_search_results: Evaluate up to 100 returned creator IDs against SaaS hide and deduplication rules.
find_similar_creators: Find a bounded page of creators similar to one source creator on a selected target platform.
get_collection_import_template: Download the SaaS owned-creator import template.
get_creator_contacts: Retrieve visible contact data for one creator when external outreach is explicitly required; this can consume contact quota.
get_crm_import_template: Download the SaaS CRM channel import template.
get_export: Read one authorized asynchronous export task and its readiness state.
get_export_download: Prepare a safe download reference for one ready authorized export; file bytes are never embedded in MCP JSON.
get_monitor_auto_track_import_template: Get the validated HTTPS download reference for the SaaS auto-track creator workbook.
get_monitor_auto_track_rule: Get one authorized auto-track rule and its creator set.
get_monitor_import_template: Get the validated HTTPS download reference for the SaaS video task import workbook.
list_creator_search_filter_options: List stable SaaS hide and deduplication choices for creator search.
list_exports: List authorized asynchronous export tasks with bounded pagination.
list_monitor_auto_track_rules: List auto-track rules in one authorized video monitor project.
list_monitor_labels: List the authorized account's video monitor labels, optionally by group.
list_not_interested_creators: List creators marked as Not interested for the authorized account.
list_tool_pricing: List current Skill Credit unit prices for public actions, including authorized account overrides.
monitor_history: Read time-series performance history for a monitored video task.
monitor_list: List video monitoring projects available to the authorized account.
monitor_summary: Read aggregate performance summary for a video monitoring project.
monitor_tasks: List tracked videos and creators in a video monitoring project.
prepare_crm_import_report_download: Download failed or repeated CRM import rows as SaaS Excel.
prepare_monitor_auto_track_import_report: Create a one-time download URL for a bounded auto-track import failure workbook.
prepare_monitor_dashboard_report_downloa: Create a one-time download URL for an authorized monitoring dashboard workbook.
prepare_monitor_import_report_download: Create a one-time download URL for a bounded task import failure workbook.
prepare_monitor_project_report_download: Create a one-time download URL for an authorized project monitoring workbook.
prepare_monitor_task_report_download: Create a one-time download URL for one authorized video monitoring task workbook.
preview_collection_add_to_crm: Preview add one whole collection + platform slice to CRM.
preview_collection_batch_copy: Preview batch copy from one source collection.
preview_collection_batch_delete: Preview batch delete within one source collection.
preview_collection_batch_label: Preview batch label within one source collection.
preview_collection_batch_move: Preview batch move within one source collection.
preview_collection_unlock_audience: Preview unlock audience analysis for one source collection.
preview_creator_export: Estimate deep creator export, email, and WhatsApp business quota without creating an export task.
preview_crm_batch_update: Preview CRM batch update target set.
quota: Read authoritative Credit and execution access for the authorized account without claiming a trial or consuming Credit. The response includes execution_available, claim_eligible, trial_claimed and, when needed, a Dashboard or billing action. Remaining Credit alone does not grant execution access.
remove_monitor_task_labels: Remove up to 100 labels from up to 100 tasks in one authorized monitoring project.
remove_not_interested_creators: Remove the Not interested mark from up to 100 same-platform creator IDs.
replace_monitor_task_labels: Replace one label group on exactly one authorized video monitor task.
update_monitor_label: Rename one authorized video monitor label and optionally move its group.
validate_collection_add_to_crm: Validate add one whole collection + platform slice to CRM.
validate_collection_batch_copy: Validate batch copy from one source collection.
validate_collection_batch_delete: Validate batch delete within one source collection.
validate_collection_batch_label: Validate batch label within one source collection.
validate_collection_batch_move: Validate batch move within one source collection.
validate_collection_unlock_audience: Validate unlock audience analysis for one source collection.
